text: Many festivals have a religious or seasonal origin. Weihnachten is celebrated mostly on the evening of 24 December (Heiligabend), with a tree, presents and a family meal. Silvester is New Year's Eve, with fireworks at midnight, and carnival (Karneval, Fasching, Fastnacht) takes place in late winter, especially in the Rhineland and in Switzerland.

Germany celebrates its national day on 3 October (Tag der Deutschen Einheit), Austria on 26 October and Switzerland on 1 August. A birthday is important: do not wish someone a happy birthday early, as it is thought to bring bad luck, and bring a small gift if you are invited home.
